title: Correlating and Predicting Human Evaluations of Language Models from Natural Language Processing Benchmarks
reasoning: The paper benchmarks and evaluates language models on several topics related to ethics and religion. Specifically, the model evaluation taxonomy includes a 'Religion & spirituality' subcategory (Figure 7 and Table 2), and the academic benchmarks used in the study include 'MMLU moral disputes', 'MMLU moral scenarios', and 'MMLU world religions' (Table 1).
